intro.h2: A kitchen planned before anyone opens a wall
paragraphs: JDI Construction has handled kitchen remodeling in Vancouver, WA and across the river in Portland since 2007. It is a family business with its headquarters at 1419 Broadway Street downtown, and more than 500 projects behind it.

The approach is simple: scope, budget, timeline, materials and permits are settled before construction starts. You get a signed, line-item estimate, a dedicated project manager and a client portal with daily reports and progress photos. Northwest homes come with older framing, wet winters and past remodel work hidden in the walls, and the team plans for that from day one. Every remodel is backed by a 5-year written workmanship warranty.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Vancouver, WA, and the rest of the house

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: From cabinet refreshes to layout changes with custom cabinetry and stone. The team plans better layouts, smarter storage, durable countertops and improved lighting that suit the character of your house. The firm's cost calculator puts Vancouver-area kitchens at a starting point of $28,000.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen in Vancouver, WA 98685 with white shaker cabinets, white island, subway tile and stainless double wall ovens

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Hall baths, guest baths, primary suites and accessibility-friendly baths with walk-in showers, custom tile, better lighting and more storage. Layouts are reworked so the room feels larger. Bathroom projects start at $9,000 on the firm's calculator, and plumbing and electrical stay under the same team.

image.alt: Primary bathroom remodel by JDI Construction with freestanding tub under a picture window, marble-look walls and wood slat accents

items.name: Whole-Home Remodeling, Additions and ADUs
items.blurb: Whole-home renovations of 1920s bungalows, mid-century houses and newer builds, plus additions and ADUs built to current Washington and Oregon code. Flow, finishes and systems are updated together under one plan. Whole-home projects start at $85,000 on the firm's calculator.

image.alt: Open living, dining and kitchen area with blue cabinetry and light wood floors from a JDI whole-house remodel

items.name: Exterior Remodeling
items.blurb: Siding, windows, decks and full exterior facelifts built for Pacific Northwest weather. A house that takes rain for half the year needs details that keep water out, and the same project manager coordinates exterior trades the way the team runs an interior remodel.

about.h2: A family business that started with one truck
about.text: Alex Kulchitskiy founded JDI Construction in 2007 with a simple idea: treat every home like your own family's, give honest timelines instead of hopeful ones, and stay until the work is right. What began as a one-truck operation in Portland is now a full design-build team based in downtown Vancouver. Arthur Kulchitskiy leads the company as Chief Executive Officer, and one La Center family wrote that Art went with them to pick tile and countertops himself. The name stands for Just Dream It, but the team reads it as doing the work right the first time.

process.h2: From first call to final walkthrough

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.text: A remodeling consultant visits your home to talk through your vision, budget, timeline and goals, then prepares a detailed estimate.

steps.title: Design phase
steps.text: After you sign the design agreement, designers create layout plans and 3D renders, build mood boards and visit partner showrooms with you to pick finishes.

steps.title: Budget and scheduling
steps.text: Every choice is checked against your budget, materials are ordered, permits are filed and construction is scheduled before demolition begins.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: A pre-construction meeting sets expectations. Your project manager coordinates trades, inspections and vendors while the portal keeps you updated.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: The team reviews the finished work with you and hands over product documentation, vendor warranties and the 5-year warranty.

service_area.h2: Clark County towns and Portland neighborhoods we cover
service_area.text: JDI is based in downtown Vancouver and works throughout Clark County, with a Portland office at 111 SW 5th Ave open by appointment. The team pulls permits with the City of Vancouver, City of Portland, Clark County and Multnomah County. Kitchens, baths, whole-home remodels and ADUs are built on both sides of the river. If your town is not listed, call and ask; the firm says it travels for the right project.

faq.h2: Common questions about remodeling with JDI

items.q: What does a kitchen remodel cost in Vancouver, WA?
items.a: JDI's online calculators start kitchens at $28,000, bathrooms at $9,000 and whole-home remodels at $85,000, and show a range in about 90 seconds without a sales call. For a firm number, book the free, no-pressure estimate. Work starts only after you sign a line-item estimate with the scope and price on paper.

items.q: Do you work on both sides of the river?
items.a: Yes. JDI holds Washington license JDICOCN932KZ and Oregon CCB 176101, so it can build in Clark County and the Portland metro. The headquarters is at 1419 Broadway Street in Vancouver, and a Portland office at 111 SW 5th Ave, Suite 3150 is open by appointment.

JDI does. When the work needs permits, the team files them with the City of Vancouver, City of Portland, Clark County or Multnomah County and builds that time into the schedule. During construction your project manager schedules city inspections and coordinates the trades, so you are not chasing inspectors yourself.

Every remodel JDI builds comes with a 5-year written workmanship warranty, backed by the same local team. At the final walkthrough you also receive documentation of installed products and manufacturer warranties on materials. The about page notes the team still picks up when a client from 2009 calls about a hinge.

Yes. JDI works with two lending partners, Lend Home Improvements and Medallion Bank, an FDIC-insured bank. Each application opens on the lender's own secure site and the lender makes the credit decision, so financing is subject to credit approval. Call (360) 844-3985 if you want help choosing between them.
